name: Low ground north of Potter's Ditch, west of the Channelsea

boundaryReview.note: Local review envelope in the eastern part of the field; clipped to the dry compartment north of Potter’s Ditch and west of Channelsea. The western edge is an uncertainty transition, not a mapped embankment.

method: Interpolate the two local ground observations along northing within a restricted dry compartment, with a ten-metre blend at the review boundary. Do not borrow higher bank heights from across Potter’s Ditch or Channelsea.
limitations: Two margin/ground dots constrain this local surface; the unmeasured interior and cross-valley slope remain interpreted.
The western review edge is an uncertainty transition, not a historical embankment.
Water-side slopes and the 0.3m shoreline transition are illustrative; neither a continuous crest nor a surveyed cross-section is established.
The northern bridge, nearby building and raised works bank lie outside this correction.
Datum conversion, bed and water heights remain provisional. This surface is not applied to the flood solver.
